extracted.name: Rhubarb Slush
extracted.description: This refreshing rhubarb slush is an old-fashioned summertime drink made with fresh rhubarb, orange juice, lemonade, and fizzy soda. Gin is optional!
ingredient_lines: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
1 (6 ounce) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage, chilled
instruction_lines: Place rhubarb in a large saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and cook until tender.
Drain; mash or purée in a blender.
Stir together rhubarb purée, sugar, orange juice concentrate, lemonade concentrate, gin, and water.
Freeze for 1 to 3 hours, depending on the consistency you like.
Place scoops of the frozen mixture into serving glasses and fill the rest of the glass with lemon-lime soda.
